These are SDK patterns for the user's own application; the agent is not told to run them against live services.

Two optional broken 'See Also' pointers: references/connections.md:207 links ../../agents/references/tools.md and references/evaluations.md:312 links ./datasets.md; neither exists in the skill or upstream repo, and the content they point to (agent tools, datasets) is covered in SKILL.md:93-167 and SKILL.md:227-254. Also references/connections.md:60 sample prints the API key to the console, contradicting its own best practice at line 201 ('Never log credentials'); users should drop that line. The evaluations reference API shape (client.evaluations.create with inline data) may not match the current SDK.
